name: ink
description: Write from a prompt or rewrite supplied text with the shared Ink model.

interface.longDescription:
Ink is a writing tool that rewrites AI drafts into words you would actually use. It deslops stiff, generic writing and keeps your meaning intact.

Use it on emails, cover letters, reports, product updates and LinkedIn posts: paste a draft and ask to rewrite it with Ink. Ink runs its own rewriting model, then checks the result for the names, numbers, dates, quotes, citations and links you wrote, and warns you if one goes missing. Compare shows exactly what changed, so you can copy the result with confidence.

Choose a light, balanced or strong rewrite for work, casual or academic writing. Personal voice profiles are coming soon. PDF and DOCX rewriting is planned.

Ask Ink to write from a prompt with its shared model. Writing jobs use the same job and feedback tools.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite my draft in a natural voice while keeping its meaning.
Give my email a light edit, keeping names, numbers and links intact.
Write a short project update from my notes.

positive.prompt: Check whether my Ink account is ready and which writing model I can use.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows readiness, allowance (unlimited for the reviewer account) and the shared Ink model, or relays the Ink setup link. Explains that personal voice profiles are coming soon and never labels shared output as a trained personal voice.

positive.prompt: Rewrite with Ink: I utilize this process in order to work.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the shared Ink model with a fresh UUID idempotency key and preserves meaning. Shows the result in the Ink widget with Copy, Compare and fullscreen. The text includes a Job ID: <uuid> line. Retries reuse the same key and arguments.

positive.description: Write from a prompt and retrieve the job
positive.prompt: Write a report of about 1000 words with Ink about a six-week pilot of a support chatbot. Check the job and show the text when it is finished.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the shared Ink model, a fresh UUID idempotency key and output-word billing. For a pending response, polls the returned Job ID and retrieves the completed text. The widget labels the input Prompt and the result Output, hides source comparison and keeps Copy and feedback. Reports actual progress and charges, without an estimated completion percentage. Retries reuse the same key and arguments. Another account’s job returns not_found.

positive.prompt: Cancel my current Ink rewrite job.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the Job ID from the rewrite to request cancellation and reports the actual state and whether cancellation is pending. The result text includes a Job ID: <uuid> line. Repeating cancellation is safe.

positive.description: Give and clear feedback from the widget
positive.prompt: In the Ink widget, I click thumbs down, pick a reason and send the feedback, then click Clear feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: The person clicks thumbs down in the Ink widget, picks a reason and sends feedback, then clicks Clear feedback. Before sending, the widget shows that feedback shares the original and rewritten text and any note with Ink to improve and train its models, and for how long. It uses feedback_note_retention_days from the job or result, 90 days by default. Both ratings accept an optional note of up to 500 characters, and only down accepts fixed reasons. Clear feedback removes the saved rating, reasons, shared text and note while preserving the rewrite. Both tools are app-only and invoked only by the widget at the person's request. The assistant does not send feedback on its own or call feedback tools from chat.

negative.prompt: Import my emails and train my Ink voice here.
Rate my last Ink rewrite thumbs up for me.

review.commerce_description: Ink does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT. Public users buy an Ink plan or start an eligible trial on ink.ego.ist, where billing is managed. The reviewer demo account has unlimited use and needs no plan or card.

publication.release_notes: Ink 0.2.1: clearer error actions in the widget and connection screen.
